mapper.insert: INSERT INTO DS_BANK_BNKBASE (BNK_NO, BNK_NM, WEB_SITE, EBNK_URL, BALANCE_URL, TEL_BNK, LINK_MAN, LINK_MAN_TEL, LINK_MAN_FAX, LINK_MAN_EMAIL, DIS_ORDER, DIS_FLG, C_TIME, C_MAN, E_TIME, E_MAN, STATUS) VALUES( #{bnkNo}, #{bnkNm}, #{webSite}, #{ebnkUrl}, #{balanceUrl}, #{telBnk}, #{linkMan}, #{linkManTel}, #{linkManFax}, #{linkManEmail}, #{disOrder}, #{disFlg}, SYSDATE, #{cMan}, SYSDATE, #{eMan}, #{status} )
mapper.update: UPDATE DS_BANK_BNKBASE SET BNK_NM = #{bnkNm}, WEB_SITE = #{webSite}, EBNK_URL = #{ebnkUrl}, BALANCE_URL = #{balanceUrl}, TEL_BNK = #{telBnk}, LINK_MAN = #{linkMan}, LINK_MAN_TEL = #{linkManTel}, LINK_MAN_FAX = #{linkManFax}, LINK_MAN_EMAIL = #{linkManEmail}, DIS_ORDER = #{disOrder}, DIS_FLG = #{disFlg}, E_TIME = sysdate, E_MAN = #{eMan}, STATUS = #{status} WHERE BNK_NO = #{bnkNo}
mapper.select: SELECT BNK_NO, BNK_NM, WEB_SITE, EBNK_URL, BALANCE_URL, TEL_BNK, LINK_MAN, LINK_MAN_TEL, LINK_MAN_FAX, LINK_MAN_EMAIL, DIS_ORDER, DIS_FLG, C_TIME, C_MAN, E_TIME, E_MAN, STATUS FROM DS_BANK_BNKBASE WHERE BNK_NO = #{bnkNo}

SELECT BNK_NO, BNK_NM, WEB_SITE, EBNK_URL, BALANCE_URL, TEL_BNK, LINK_MAN, LINK_MAN_TEL, LINK_MAN_FAX, LINK_MAN_EMAIL, DIS_ORDER, DIS_FLG, C_TIME, C_MAN, E_TIME, E_MAN, STATUS FROM DS_BANK_BNKBASE WHERE 1 = 1
AND BNK_NO = #{sp.bnkNo}
AND BNK_NM LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%', #{sp.bankName}),'%')
ORDER BY BNK_NO

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DS_BANK_BNKBASE WHERE 1= 1
AND BNK_NO = #{sp.bnkNo}
AND BNK_NM LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%', #{sp.bankName}),'%')
ORDER BY DIS_ORDER
